state.seed_assertion: If you intend to rely on the exception for disproportionate effort, you must be able to justify this, and you must take other measures to protect people's rights.

sentences.1: If you intend to rely on the exception for disproportionate effort, you must be able to justify this, and you must take other measures to protect people's rights.
sentences.2: If you intend to rely on the exception for disproportionate effort, you must be able to justify this, and you must take other measures to protect people's rights.
sentences.3: A DPIA is required for processing of personal data that has not been obtained direct from the data subject in circumstances where the controller considers that compliance with Article 14 would prove impossible or involve disproportionate effort.
sentences.4: Invisible processing Processing of personal data that has not been obtained direct from the data subject in circumstances where the controller considers that compliance with Article 14 would prove impossible or involve disproportionate effort
sentences.5: Processing of personal data obtained from somewhere other than directly from the individual, in circumstances where the controller considers that compliance with Article 14 would prove impossible or involve disproportionate effort, requires a DPIA where this processing is combined with any of the criteria from the European guidelines.
sentences.6: Invisible processing: processing of personal data that has not been obtained direct from the data subject in circumstances where the controller considers that compliance with Article 14 would prove impossible or involve disproportionate effort.
sentences.7: You may be able to justify a decision not to carry out a DPIA if you are confident that the processing is nevertheless unlikely to result in a high risk, but you should document your reasons.
sentences.8: You may be able to justify a decision not to carry out a DPIA if you are confident that the processing is nevertheless unlikely to result in a high risk, but you should document your reasons.
sentences.9: If a controller intends to rely on the exception for disproportionate effort in invisible processing, the controller must be able to justify this and must take other measures to protect people's rights, including publishing privacy information and carrying out a DPIA.
sentences.10: If you intend to rely on the exception for disproportionate effort, you must be able to justify this, and you must take other measures to protect people's rights.
sentences.11: In accordance with GDPR Article 35(4), the DPC has determined that a DPIA will be mandatory for indirectly sourcing personal data where GDPR transparency requirements are not being met, including when relying on exemptions based on impossibility or disproportionate effort, where a documented screening or preliminary risk assessment indicates that the processing operation is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
sentences.12: But you must consult the ICO if your DPIA identifies a high risk and you cannot take measures to reduce that risk.
